meta_description: The SHARP HSNKL Half Marathon 2026: October 25 at Dataran Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur. A single-distance 21.1K electronics-brand race with registration open.
dek: Set for 25 October 2026 at Dataran Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur, this SHARP-branded half marathon is a single-distance 21.1K with registration open. An electronics-brand race at Malaysia's most historic square.
verdict: The SHARP HSNKL Half Marathon brings the Japanese electronics brand to Dataran Merdeka — KL's historic independence square — for a focused, single-distance 21.1K. The SHARP brand backing suggests above-average production values and quality race merchandise. Dataran Merdeka is one of KL's most iconic start/finish venues, with the Sultan Abdul Samad Building as backdrop. Registration is open. A solid, brand-backed KL half marathon at a world-class venue.
